title: Solver runtime comparison with overlapping 95% CIs
what: small ~2.8 ms (~2.0%) mean difference between solver_v2 and solver_v1, within noise

reader_questions.question: What is the primary quantitative finding or value?
reader_questions.expected: solver_v2 averages 139.2 ms vs solver_v1 142.0 ms (-2.8 ms / -2.0%), showing no reliable speedup.

reader_questions.question: Is the difference clearly outside uncertainty or noise?
reader_questions.expected: No; the 95% CIs (130.3–148.1 ms vs 133.4–150.6 ms) overlap heavily across the 10 trials.

reader_questions.question: What caveat, outlier, control, or subgroup pattern matters?
reader_questions.expected: Run-to-run SD (~12 ms) is more than four times larger than the 2.8 ms mean difference.
